BooRingTiles.name: Cluster sprites 3 and 8: Boo/bat ceiling
summary: Cluster sprite types 3 and 8 (probably Boo ceiling and bat ceiling), 20 slots, type in [$1892], state in [$0F86].
State 0: idle on the ceiling, swaying and bobbing (bats only hang). Slot 0 wakes a random idle slot every 8 frames.
State 1: after a short delay swoops at Mario (aimed speed), then returns to its home height and goes idle.
Hurts Mario on contact. Also holds the shared drawing routine ($02FD48).

BatCeilingTiles.name: Bonus 1-up cluster sprite, Mario contact
summary: BatCeilingTiles: bat tile table. Then $02FDBC: cluster sprite type 1 (bonus game 1-up): falls, bounces off the edges,
gives a 1-UP score sprite when Mario touches it, and draws using OAM slots at $90-$AC.
$02FE71: cluster sprite contact check; calls CODE_02F9F5 (hurt Mario or lose Yoshi) on overlap.

s02FEC5.name: Unused: cluster despawn distance tables
summary: Used only by the unused despawn code at $02FECD.

s02FECD.name: Cluster despawn (unused), OAM table, helpers
summary: $02FECD: unused off-screen despawn check. $02FF50/$02FF64: OAM offset tables.
$02FF6C: spawn a 1-UP score sprite at the cluster sprite. $02FF98/$02FFA3: apply X / Y speed to position (16-bit, 4-bit fraction).
$02FFD1: Wiggler helper that sets sprite Y speed (0 or $18).

s02FFE2.name: Padding ($FF) to the end of the bank
